headline: Hungarians Would Rather Not Start Renovations, Waiting for Promised Subsidies
summary: Strong forint has limited price rises for mostly imported building materials, but few buyers are starting renovations. Developers are waiting for cheaper loans, and the insolvency of Bayer Construct adds financing uncertainty.
why: Construction and building materials are sensitive to interest rates and credit conditions, which shape the outlook for the housing and renovation market.
